def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    starting_assets = 515.0
    ending_assets = 602.5
    high_water_mark = 540.0
    hurdle_rate = 0.05
    management_fee_rate = 0.02
    performance_fee_rate = 0.20

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    hurdle_value = starting_assets * (1 + hurdle_rate)
    performance_fee_threshold = max(high_water_mark, hurdle_value)
    management_fee = ending_assets * management_fee_rate
    performance_fee = max(0.0, ending_assets - performance_fee_threshold) * performance_fee_rate
    net_ending_assets = ending_assets - management_fee - performance_fee
    answer = (net_ending_assets / starting_assets - 1) * 100

    # return answer
    return round(answer, 3)
